entities.name: Medomai
entities.description: Ancient male sphinx and seer, the Wandering Oracle, who appears in Meletis at moments of historical import.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: Theran city where Medomai is usually seen.

entities.name: Anthousa
entities.description: Informed Daxos that Nyxborn creatures were attacking humanity.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City shown to Daxos and Elspeth in a vision under siege.

events.summary: Anthousa tells Daxos Nyxborn creatures are attacking humanity; Daxos and Elspeth decide to seek Medomai.
Medomai explains the origins of the gods and shows Daxos and Elspeth disastrous predictions and a vision of Akros under siege.
events.quote: Medomai explained the origins of the gods of Theros

relations.quote: The wise and ancient sphinx Medomai is usually seen in Meletis
